title: Claude explains AI token pricing and caching effects on chat costs #ClaudeAI #AIPricing #TokenCache
description: Claude offers a permanent discount on input token prices through cached reads. Cached input means the AI reuses previously processed text, charging only a fraction of the normal rate when prompts remain identical down to the character. The cache hit discount disappears when prompts change dynamically, such as adding a current date at the top, causing each interaction to pay full price. Long chats trigger automatic summaries, which reset the cache and remove the discounted reads until the context rebuilds. Understanding cached versus fresh input token billing reveals that much of what users pay for is repeated text, not new content. This insight helps optimize AI usage costs by structuring prompts to maximize cache hits and minimize expensive full reads. #ClaudeAI #AIPricing #CacheDiscount #TokenBilling #AIOptimization #PromptEngineering #ChatPricing #AIUsage #CachedReads #TokenEconomics #ArtificialIntelligence #CostEfficiency #AICosts #PromptStrategy #LongChatManagement
